en.title: T93.Lab Collection & Market Platform
en.summary: Notion-powered collectible vault with valuation analytics, private access, scheduled publishing, market lookup, and commerce prototypes.
en.challenge: A private trading-card collection needed to work as a searchable collection, valuation dashboard, wishlist, and member-only market experience while keeping editorial data easy to maintain.
contribution: Built the static-site generation pipeline from Notion data, including cached exchange rates and scheduled publishing.
Designed collection filters, valuation analytics, wishlists, market lookup, shopping, auction, cart, and grading-service prototypes.
Added Supabase Google identity, independent authorization, admin review, and protected aggregate market APIs.
technical: Python/Jinja2 build process converts Notion content into deployable static pages and reusable partials.
Cloudflare Pages and Functions protect private routes and expose server-side APIs without leaking service credentials.
Supabase Auth/Postgres provides identity and access boundaries; GitHub Actions rebuilds hourly and refreshes market data on a schedule.

architecture.label: Content source
architecture.detail: Notion databases hold collection metadata, research notes, prices, and wishlists.

architecture.label: Build pipeline
architecture.detail: Python fetches and normalizes records, caches exchange rates, and renders Jinja2 pages.

architecture.label: Delivery
architecture.detail: GitHub Actions publishes the generated site to Cloudflare Pages on schedule or demand.

architecture.label: Private services
architecture.detail: Cloudflare middleware/Functions and Supabase Auth/Postgres protect users, admin data, and aggregate APIs.

outcomes: Created one product surface for collection browsing, value analysis, wishlists, and authenticated market demos.
Separated editorial collection data from transaction-oriented architecture so commerce features can evolve safely.
Connected aggregate T93 market value to the stock workspace through a server-only API.

zh.title: T93.Lab 收藏與市場平台
zh.summary: 以 Notion 驅動的收藏品管理庫，整合估值分析、私人存取、排程發布、市場查詢與商務原型。
zh.status: 持續進行中的客戶產品
zh.role: 產品負責人與全端工程師
zh.challenge: 私人卡牌收藏需要同時成為可搜尋的收藏庫、估值儀表板、願望清單與會員限定市場體驗，並讓編輯資料維持容易管理。
contribution: 以 Notion 資料建置靜態網站產生管線，包含匯率快取與排程發布。
設計收藏篩選、估值分析、願望清單、市場查詢、購物、拍賣、購物車與鑑定服務原型。
加入 Supabase Google 身分驗證、獨立授權、管理員審核與受保護的市場彙總 API。
technical: Python 與 Jinja2 建置流程將 Notion 內容轉換為可部署的靜態頁面及可重用局部模板。
Cloudflare Pages 與 Functions 保護私人路由，並提供伺服器端 API，避免洩漏服務憑證。
Supabase Auth 與 Postgres 提供身分及存取邊界；GitHub Actions 每小時重建並排程更新市場資料。

architecture.label: 內容來源
architecture.detail: Notion 資料庫保存收藏詮釋資料、研究筆記、價格與願望清單。

architecture.label: 建置管線
architecture.detail: Python 擷取並標準化紀錄、快取匯率，再渲染 Jinja2 頁面。

architecture.label: 交付
architecture.detail: GitHub Actions 依排程或需求將產生的網站發布至 Cloudflare Pages。

architecture.label: 私人服務
architecture.detail: Cloudflare 中介軟體與 Functions 搭配 Supabase Auth／Postgres，保護使用者、管理資料及彙總 API。

outcomes: 建立單一產品介面，整合收藏瀏覽、價值分析、願望清單與身分驗證市場展示。
將編輯型收藏資料與交易導向架構分離，使商務功能能安全演進。
透過僅限伺服器存取的 API，將 T93 市場彙總價值連接至投資工作區。
